instance.basis: RETROSPECTIVE — public record. As-of approximately 01:10 on 16 April 2013, minutes after the second underground communications vault was breached near the Metcalf transmission substation (per FERC-docket accounts and subsequent public reporting). Evidence in hand at that moment: two buried telecom vaults opened and their fiber trunks deliberately severed within minutes of each other, disabling 911 and landline/cell service in the area immediately adjacent to a high-value transmission asset. Target focus assessed specific: the cuts were precise, coordinated across two carriers' vaults, and geographically converged on one substation's service area. Means confirmed present: the severing itself demonstrates tools and proficiency in hand. Tempo accelerating: two vaults defeated inside a quarter hour. Proximity at_or_near_target: the actor was physically working the conduit serving the site. Source credibility high: physical evidence and carrier outage telemetry. Raise rationale per raise_guidance: specific_target + confirmed means + accelerating tempo -> consider critical; at_or_near_target + specific_target is an independent strong raise signal. The rifle attack on the transformer bank began at approximately 01:31; this record is what an analyst holding the vault-breach evidence could have written in the roughly 20-minute window before it.
